what.question: What exactly does Orbit do?
what.answer: It builds a persistent model of your career — your profile and goal — then uses three specialized AI agents to analyze your skill gaps, generate an ordered roadmap to close them, and give you feedback on your CV against your specific target role.

control.question: Is the AI making decisions for me?
control.answer: No. Every output is advisory. You control every action a recommendation suggests — nothing executes on your behalf, and you can override or ignore any recommendation at any time.

explain.question: Can I see why the AI recommended something?
explain.answer: Yes, on request, for every output. Explanations are grounded in your actual profile and goal data — never a generic justification.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: It's yours. You can view everything stored about you at any time, delete specific data independent of your account, or delete your account entirely — which removes everything.

pricing.question: Do I need to pay to get started?
pricing.answer: There's a free tier to start. You can view and manage your subscription, or cancel, at any time.
